title: Teen Boy in White Suit Outdoors, 1938 California Vintage Photo
back_text_transcription:
FADE PROOF
SEP 6 1938
Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
817 A
description: Full-length outdoor portrait of a well-groomed teenage boy posing in a crisp all-white suit, striped necktie, and white shoes. He stands on a tiled walkway outside a clapboard house framed by climbing ivy and multi-pane windows, likely dressed for a formal occasion such as a confirmation, graduation, or summer social event in late-1930s Southern California.
